scope: Mandatory hosted C-compatibility library macros; not core predefined preprocessing macros; implementation may expose extra nonconflicting macros, but these are not mandatory.

review_basis.cpp03: Existing source-reviewed repository ledger/inventory; original PDF absent; no fresh original ISO2003 read claimed.
review_basis.c90: Selected indexed primary PDF excerpts, not full independent clause-by-clause re-review.
review_basis.amendment1: Primary ISO publisher preview read at 7.1.4 and 7.15.1; preview ends before 7.16.1.
